description:
Two-leg journey to Israel (YYZ?FRA?TLV). Leg 1 completed on time. Leg 2 (FRA?TLV) cancelled due to extraordinary circumstance (cancellation code WEAT). Customer stranded at FRA (midpoint) � did not return to YYZ, did not reach TLV. Under ASL, extraordinary circumstance = airline exempt. 

Prerequisites:
PNR: single passenger Talia Friedman (Adult). Journey: 2 legs: Leg 1 AC 873 YYZ?FRA (on time); Leg 2 AC 9042 FRA?TLV (CANCELLED). Cancellation code on Leg 2: WEAT (Severe weather � Extraordinary Circumstance). Customer action: Stranded at FRA (midpoint). Did NOT return to YYZ. Did NOT reach TLV. No Travel status: Incomplete. Fallback: FALSE. MSL: Leg 2 (FRA?TLV). Regime: ASL (Israel destination) + APPR (Canadian origin) + potentially EU 261 (FRA = EU). Result: NOT ELIGIBLE under all regimes.
